policy.source_code: PlotPilot baseline remains under the existing LICENSE; P0 adds no copied third-party source.
policy.npm: All direct and lock-resolved frontend packages are listed with lock path, license metadata, resolved URL and integrity when present.
policy.python: M0 verification runtime packages are listed from importlib.metadata; the checked-in requirements files remain the dependency declaration.
policy.review: Any package with missing license metadata blocks release until its upstream notice is reviewed.
